reviews.text: I've been a customer of Animalitos Polanco for several years now. Honestly, the service is excellent and the care they give the animals is outstanding! Every month, Erika takes care of my dog ​​Stella, a mini Yorkie who gets very nervous when it's her turn for a bath. Erika is so attentive and affectionate with her that she sometimes falls asleep during the service. She always greets Stella with so much love and happiness; you can tell she loves her job and the animals she cares for. Everyone at this location is incredibly kind and caring towards the animals! I highly recommend them if you have pets that need a bath and grooming, veterinary care, or hospitalization!

Erika from Grooming is the best. She treats dogs with genuine affection and incredible patience. My dog ​​always leaves happy and calm, and it's clear he trusts her completely. Erika is super attentive and careful, and you can tell she truly loves what she does. I recommend her 100%! ❤️🐾 …

Excellent service from Erika, who has bathed my dogs for years. Her treatment of pets is a 10/10. We are currently taking my Dachshund there for medical attention, and the doctors are very kind and attentive at all times. Both customer service and reception staff are excellent.

I think it's a wonderful place, professional, and everyone who works there is incredibly friendly.
Erika, in particular, is the only person I trust to groom, bathe, and brush my dog. He's 14 years old and can barely see, and Erika takes such good care of him.
Congratulations!
Excellent place with an amazing staff. Erika, in particular, has always treated my English bulldog with the utmost care and, above all, with so much love. Highly recommended.
Dr. Gabriel Z treated me incredibly well; he was incredibly patient with the owners. If you go there, ask for him.
Eri is the best at bathing and grooming dogs, she's wonderful! She takes great care of the dogs, is always attentive to them, and pampers them a lot.

If I could, I'd give Erika 10 stars. I've been taking my dog ​​and cat to her for almost 5 years. Erika is kind to us, and the way she treats my dog ​​and cat is wonderful. You can see the love and patience she has for them, and she clearly enjoys what she does. Erika is the best dog and cat groomer. I highly recommend her.
Excellent service
Thanks for your review, Fernando! We're happy to have your 5-star rating.

The worst of the worst! They kill animals, do nothing, and charge you, pretending it's their last day on earth. 70,000 pesos for 5 days for doing absolutely nothing for my cat and almost killing him. Thank God I got him out of there and he was saved at another clinic. Many people told me the same thing about those charlatans. Besides, everything was filthy, full of fur. Cats and dogs kept together. They charge for diapers and use other dogs' diapers, fur and all. They charge for food and give them dried-out food from the previous day. Terrible service, terrible staff. Everything was awful!!!

The receptionist provided terrible service. Last night I took a small dog I rescued from a house where he was being kept in bad conditions. I wanted him examined, vaccinated, and to stay overnight. Whenever I spoke to the receptionist, she had an elitist attitude and just kept saying "Uh-huh." She offered absolutely no customer service. I don't understand why they employ people like that. If they treat us, who understand, like this, I can't imagine how they treat animals.
Terrible service, they don't have a cardiologist and they get rid of the patient. They tell you they'll send you the results you've paid for, but they never do; they steal from you.
We love seeing 5-star reviews. At Animalitos, we're always here to serve you, Sofia.

Sabdi, we'd like to know what happened during your visit.
If you provide us with your contact information, we can discuss your case further.
Excellent service! My dog ​​came through surgery great. Dr. Jorge Praxedis is a very good doctor; he explains everything in detail and is very attentive to the little ones. 👌🏻
We're glad to hear you enjoyed your experience at Animalitos Polanco, Alfonso. Don't forget we're always ready to serve you.

Janet, the receptionist, was awful! Her service and attention were disgusting. If she doesn't like her job, I don't know why she's working as a receptionist. She always has a terrible attitude and looks awful. A truly disgusting receptionist.
The staff do not have identification cards
Thank you for the 5-star review! We are here to serve you.

Terrible service. I arrived at 10:30 PM and waited patiently until 11:50 PM because they were attending to another dog, which I understood, so I sat down and waited. Another dog arrived around midnight, and they basically ignored me. They took that dog in first to check vital signs and everything, even though I waited so long and they didn't even ask what was wrong with my dog. The only redeeming quality was the security guard who was very attentive at night and cared more about my dog ​​than the "doctors" on duty. You're better off going to Pet Path; it's only 5 minutes away.
Kind
Hey, can you give me the Wi-Fi password?
Thanks for those 5 stars, Rodrick! Animalitos will always be your home.
It's great to hear you're satisfied, Erik, thank you for your review.
Good service, professional, affordable prices, the veterinarians explain everything in detail.

It's a terrible place. They're only interested in taking your money and don't help your pets. They're a complete disappointment in emergencies. They only know the bare minimum. They're incapable of giving medication to a patient who can't be moved.
I REPEAT, DON'T TAKE YOUR PETS THERE BECAUSE THEY WILL DIE BECAUSE THEY CAN'T PRESCRIBE ANYTHING.
I've been getting aesthetic treatments for a long time now, and I'm so happy. Erika is amazing; she's very professional and caring. Thank you so much!
They received my kitten very quickly to do a CT scan, they explained the whole procedure and what it entails very well.
Ericka provides excellent grooming service, giving your pets top-notch, high-quality care. She always treats them with lots of love and patience. Excellent service, 100% recommended :)

Terrible service for an emergency. I was told that the Polanco branch did NOT have a doctor on call. (This is the second time I've been told the same thing in a similar situation.) They sent me to the Chapultepec branch, and that branch NO LONGER EXISTS. Truly AWFUL communication between employees in an emergency. IT'S UNACCEPTABLE THAT THEIR OWN EMPLOYEES DON'T KNOW THE SERVICES THEY OFFER.
Thank you for your 5-star review, Adrian!
Thank you for your review, José Manuel. Tell us what else we can do to earn 5 stars.
My dog ​​hurt her paw on an escalator, they treated her, bandaged her up, and discharged her in three weeks! She's as good as new!
I go to the hospital for the neurologist who treats my dogs with epilepsy; the care has always been very good.
Fabiola and Dr. María Fernanda treated my puppy and me with great care and professionalism. Thank you so much.

My French bulldog came in unable to walk, in excruciating pain. At Animalitos, they performed an MRI and then a very complex emergency surgery due to the location of the hernia. They not only treated her with immense love, but they also saved her life. From the reception staff to all the doctors, thank you so much. Don't hesitate to take your pets there.

I’m new to town and was told by a previous vet that my cat was very sick. Went here and they put me at ease with a very conservative approach, rather than pushing unnecessary tests or procedures as some others do. The vet (Dr. Daniel) explained everything very clearly and was so gentle with my cat. Reception staff was really nice and professional too. I had a wonderful experience from start to finish.
They took good care of one of my cats, they were very warm.
It's an excellent place and the service is top-notch, Dr. Itzel and Fabiola.
Great service and the kindest employees Dr Natalia did a great job!
Although it's a veterinary hospital, the grooming service is excellent. My dog ​​had a terrible time at a certain chain of salons, but here she's actually happy to see Erika, who is also very kind.

Fabiola at the reception  & Angelica the Veterinarian were absolutely amazing with my dog Champ. I had to bring him in a second time in the same day and they got me in right away. Their compassion and attention to detail was very special and appreciated. They also spoke English which helped. If I have to bring Champ back to any Vet it will be here! Thank you so much to you both!
The service was excellent, from the reception staff to the doctor.
Dr. Leonel and Fabiola are very kind. My dogs love them very much. Even on vaccination days ☺️
Fabiola and Itzel (the physiotherapist) provide impeccable care. They always greet Valentino with great enthusiasm and give him the best treatment.
Fabiola is fabulous!
Excellent service, especially from Miss Fabiola! Very good attention.
Excellent service in the physiotherapy area
Excellent care from Dr. Angelica and invaluable help from Fabiola, who very attentively assisted us in administering medication. Highly recommended.
Miss Fabiola and Dr. Leonel, along with Dr. Micaela, provided excellent care, warmth, and clear explanations. Thank you so much. 🙏🏻 …
Excellent service! They helped my dog ​​with all his treatment. Thanks to doctors Natalia, Gabriel, Angelica, and Fabiola, who always welcomed us warmly.

The service from the moment you arrive at reception with Miss Fabiola is excellent. Dr. Gabriel's explanation of the prophylaxis procedure was good, and the prophylaxis itself was excellent. I highly recommend bringing your furry friends to the Hospital.
Faby provided excellent service; she was very kind and patient with my little ones and with us, answering all our questions.
I take my two cats, Piolin and Lunito, and the receptionist, Liz, always greets them with so much love and takes great care of them. She keeps me informed. Highly recommended!

Liz provided excellent service. She is always very kind, attentive, and helpful. She follows up on everything with a great attitude and makes the clinic visit much less stressful. Congratulations on having such dedicated staff!

Dr. Leonel is excellent; don't hesitate to see him.
Drs. Itzel, Natalia, and Marifer from the physical therapy department are incredibly attentive, excellent, and take great care of my baby.
And Fabiola at reception is amazing. She always answers my questions. I love coming here.
Dr. Angel and Fabiola always attend to Chocolatín with dedication and answer all his questions.

Excellent service. I'm so glad to have a hospital with this level of specialization. Since my dog ​​arrived, the care she received—she came in with a very serious dermatological issue—has been impeccable, and the changes are remarkable. We are very happy with the entire team at Animalitos Polanco.

Thank you for your attention; highly recommended.
Excellent attention and service from everyone, especially Dr. Leonel and Miss Fabiola. Thank you so much for everything and your dedication and commitment. 🙏🏻😘 …
Fabiola and Dr. Natalia provided excellent service.
I have no words for the service and attention; today my cat feels completely at ease here and has recovered from a critical condition thanks to everyone.
Larisa and Fabiola at reception and Dr. Angel are the best in the world.
Excellent service at reception, good veterinarians, and clear communication throughout. Very transparent at every step and everything explained very well.

I went because my dog ​​ate some plastic, and the procedure went very well. They gave us clear instructions every step of the way, and everything was very thorough. The service was excellent throughout. They performed an endoscopy, and everything went very well.

I took my dog ​​to the emergency vet because she had ingested a piece of plastic. They performed all the necessary tests until they found where the foreign object was lodged, and then an emergency endoscopy. The veterinarian, Ángel, explained all the procedures and tests in detail. The reception staff were incredibly kind. I'm so grateful they saved my dog's life. An hour after the procedure, my dog ​​was completely normal, lively, and eager to eat again.
Dr. Leonel Gomez and Fabiola Trejo are the best!!!! They have helped me with my dog ​​in everything he needs.
Fabiola and María Fernanda gave us excellent service.
Everything was perfect!! Fabiola was very kind and treated my dogs very well. Thank you so much for your kindness and courtesy!!

Excellent service! My dog ​​received a thorough check-up. The doctors provided excellent service and examined them from head to toe. The reception staff, Lariza and Fabiola, were very kind and friendly. I highly recommend them.

Excellent service from the receptionists Fabiola and Larisa, and also from the physiotherapy staff, especially Itzel, Mariel, and the social worker ❤️ Thank you for taking such good care of my baby girl 🤗 …
Super friendly
You have no idea what a great place to take your baby. I had to arrive at the last minute and they saved me—immediate attention and super friendly. A trustworthy vet.
The reception staff is good and very friendly; we only went for blood tests, so I don't know what the doctors are like.
The experience is always great and our little one loves them!
Excellent service
Excellent service, with good specialists
Attentive staff available at any time.
Very pleasant service

Everything was terrible. They gave me my dog ​​back even though she wasn't fully recovered from the anesthesia, and the vet who handed her over was incredibly hostile and indifferent. After the CT scan, which they gave me back in bad shape, my dog ​​started having bloody bowel movements (I can't be sure it was from the procedure). They told me she had an accident during the procedure and that they had to trim her fur a little, according to them. When I got home, I realized they had shaved a huge patch of her fur, irritating her skin all over, and they did it without my consent when they could have just cleaned her. I'm so angry because their prices aren't cheap, and it's unacceptable that our pets are treated like this. The only positive thing was the manager, who was kind and tried to resolve the situation.
Excellent service and attention
Excellent service, very friendly, professional, and they explain the entire treatment very clearly and precisely.
Excellent service, true specialists committed to their work
Very friendly, everything was very clean and organized, they explained everything in detail and calmly.

I'm sorry to hear about the bad experiences some users have had. In my case, I really find it hard to believe they're talking about the same people who cared for my cat at the Polanco branch. She was very ill for almost a month, and they were incredibly supportive and attentive the entire time, from the reception staff to the veterinarians.
Very good service
Very bad experience, the veterinarians have no knowledge.

My experience at Animalitos has been excellent. We had a femoral head salvage surgery performed on my 9-month-old puppy, Bagheera, due to a diagnosis of moderate to severe hip dysplasia.
The orthopedic surgeon, Juan Carlos, was fantastic. He patiently and kindly explained the procedure and answered all our questions.
The receptionists were also very helpful: they were always friendly and clear, providing us with all the necessary information, including the costs.
After the surgery, they kept us updated daily on Bagheera's progress, which gave us great peace of mind. Overall, the entire staff has been very attentive, answering our questions patiently and warmly.
Previously, we also had a CT scan done for our golden retriever, and we received excellent service there as well, with clear pricing and great care for our dogs.
Despite some negative reviews we've seen, our experience has been entirely positive. The doctors are highly professional, and they are known for their warmth and excellent care of the pets.
The costs have always been transparent, and we have received high-quality care from the very first contact. That's why we decided to return to this hospital to treat our second dog, Bagheera.

I highly recommend the physiotherapy offered at the hospital with Dr. Itzel. My dog, Bagheera, has separation anxiety, and they have been very patient with him; his progress is remarkable. His diagnosis is moderate to severe hip dysplasia.
We've had six appointments, and we've always received kind treatment. She explains what's being done and what routine we should follow at home, always with kindness and a positive attitude. Bagheera's mobility has improved significantly.
If you're looking for a loving, respectful, and patient approach for your dog, and want to see positive results, this is the right place with Dr. Itzel.
They don't answer calls.
They took great care of my beautiful dog. I highly recommend this lovely place, easily accessible for the area, and with super nice and comfortable facilities for us and our pets too.

I had an appointment, but when I arrived the place was very dirty and the staff were not at all empathetic. I decided it was better to take my dog ​​to Mundi for her CT scan; they were much better rated, had a better price, and the staff were incredibly kind.
For the service they offer, there are many better options in the area at more competitive prices.

I had an emergency; my dog ​​was attacked and almost lost his ear. The receptionist prioritized a registration process over the vet's appointment. After waiting over 30 minutes to find someone who actually understood it was an emergency, I had to be incredibly helpful. If you can, never go there. It was a horrible experience and terrible service.

We arrived at night with my dog ​​in bad shape. Although the hospital claims to be open 24 hours, the door was locked. There was only one veterinarian and a security guard.

The veterinarian gave her a cursory examination, said it wasn't an emergency, and left us waiting without any help. Meanwhile, her condition worsened. I had to take her to another hospital, where they finally saw her and told us she had gastric torsion. They operated on her half an hour after we arrived because it was an emergency surgery. It was a matter of minutes, and they only saved her because we managed to get to another place in time.

If your pet is in a real emergency, don't waste your time coming here at night, after the day shift. It's very likely they won't be able to help you either.
They never answer...

Be very careful with them; their negligence was total. We took our 13-year-old senior dog for a CT scan, and they didn't handle the anesthesia properly. They caused a cervical hernia that left my dog ​​paralyzed, and I had to let him rest for two days after the scan. I still haven't received the results, and my dog ​​is no longer with us.

They should be much more careful in handling these beings we love so much.
I absolutely do not recommend this place. Terrible service, negligent staff, and a complete lack of respect for the owners and their pets. Avoid them.

They're simply not recommended. Their service is terrible, negligent, and unprofessional. Avoid them completely and find another place that treats pets and their owners better. It's not worth risking such poor service.
I'll never go back.

A DEVASTATING EXPERIENCE AND NEGLIGENCE THAT COST MY RABBIT THE LIFE
I took my rabbit (a healthy animal with perfect vital signs and up-to-date veterinary checkups) for a CT scan with VERY PRECISE written instructions regarding the medications NOT to be used for anesthesia. The veterinarian who was treating him had specifically warned me about the risks and contraindications.
My rabbit died halfway through the scan. His vital signs had been stable until that point, and there was NO medical reason for this to happen. My personal veterinarian, upon learning the details, confirmed that this was serious negligence: "there was absolutely no reason for him to be at risk."
The staff was cold, curt, and completely lacking in empathy. They didn't even allow me to be present during the critical moments. In the end, after killing my pet, they decided "not to charge us for the scan"... but they did charge us for ALL the materials used. I found it utterly disrespectful and inhumane: they knew something had gone terribly wrong and still wanted a refund.

This wasn't an "accident." It was pure negligence. A place that claims to specialize in advanced animal testing and yet can't follow basic instructions or administer safe anesthesia to a healthy rabbit.
To all pet owners (especially rabbit owners, who are very sensitive to anesthesia): DO NOT come here. Find another clinic, another imaging center, another place that actually knows what it's doing and respects the lives of its patients. This experience devastated me, and I don't want anyone else to go through the same thing.
I will never return. And I hope no one else ever trusts them.
God bless and accompany Dr. Gabriel who anesthetized my little one during his CT scan.

Terrible. Given the location, you'd expect excellent service.

But it's deficient from the moment you arrive at reception—understaffed, and then it's clear they don't want to help.

This is our second and last time here. We'll find a better vet.
...the prices are very high...

I can't give it a -5 rating, but I had a VERY BAD EXPERIENCE at this vet clinic.

I took my kitten there for an emergency CT scan. From the beginning, I repeatedly asked them to be careful and gentle with her because of her age and condition. I followed the required fasting procedure, but I still had to wait four and a half hours to get her back, without any explanation.

When I got home, I noticed she was very hoarse and had a purple paw, something that had never happened to me at other veterinary hospitals. In addition, the place was under renovation, with smells, dust, and noise that I consider inappropriate and extremely stressful for our pets. In the end, they didn't even offer an apology, and everything was chaotic.

I HOPE I NEVER HAVE TO GO THERE AGAIN.

It's not about the money; I'm willing to pay what's necessary for good treatment. It's about care and respect. If you can avoid this place, please do. 🙏🏼

Today I took my dog ​​in because she was sick, and due to the urgency, I decided to stay even though the hospital is clearly under renovation. The place was extremely dirty and in a far cry from what a hospital should be (regardless of whether it's for animals). I understand that they're making improvements or installing new equipment, but that shouldn't compromise cleanliness or safety.

The medical care was okay; however, when I asked them to please shave just a little bit of hair on her tail because it was getting dirty due to her illness, they ended up cutting it, which could have caused an infection. Although they assured me that nothing would happen, it was a very unnecessary situation, and I consider the person who attended to us unprofessional.

You arrive already worried about your pet's health, and then you have to deal with facilities in poor condition and avoidable mistakes. I hope they consider not accepting patients until the place is in adequate condition, or at least be more careful and clear about their procedures.

Terrible service at the register; they have no record of payments and charges. They made me wait two hours to pay my bill after my pet had the autopsy done. I also paid for an MRI that was performed incorrectly, wasting crucial time for the procedure.

Excellent care and service; one of the best-equipped hospitals in the city. The staff is friendly and welcoming. You can tell the veterinarians love animals and are fully qualified, unlike in other places where they aren't even specialists and are only there for the money.

Poor service, doctors who don't inspire confidence, and many of them are foreigners whose licenses aren't registered with the professional registry. I understand they need a place for sample collection, but they don't allow owners to observe the procedures. The facilities are bad, with stairs that are dangerous for staff and pets. I've been to other places where you can be with your pet at all times, and they always seem busy. If they can't handle the service, they shouldn't see so many patients. Furthermore, they sell human medications, including small doses in syringes—very bad practice.

Updated recommendation:
Before going to the appointment, I called to see if they could perform an ultrasound on my dog ​​to check his condition. They said it was possible (they even gave me prices), so I took my dog ​​in. Honestly, the experience was very disappointing. The consultation was very unremarkable. In the end, the vet simply told me what was on the lab results and repeated what I had already told her. She insisted I see an oncologist (I already have an oncology diagnosis). In the end, they charged me $300, even though it was a very basic checkup. She refused to do the ultrasound because she didn't know how and didn't tell me anything about his medical history that I hadn't already provided. I decided to go back for a second opinion and even a quote for surgery, but it seems they're just trying to take my money without any qualified staff.

When I filed my complaint, the response I received was a refund, which was supposed to be processed within 48 hours (this was on February 17th), and I still haven't received it. They're completely ignoring me on WhatsApp. Honestly, what kind of people are they? They're not qualified to provide veterinary services, nor customer service. I've never had such a terrible experience with any service as I have with them.

BEFORE TAKING YOUR PETS HERE, CHECK THE REVIEWS. THEY'RE THE WORST.

Communicating by phone is a nightmare; the service is terrible. I made 16 calls in one day, and the operator kept saying the number was unavailable. When the call finally went through, no one answered. Does this mean you have to go to the branch in person for any inquiries?

They have absolutely no empathy, they make incorrect diagnoses and then try to wash their hands of it, and if you want a solution they want to charge you for everything, even breathing. It's unacceptable that they play with the lives of our little animals like this.

Animalitos Veterinary Hospital is a prime example of how mismanagement can completely ruin a place that should exist to care for animals. From the moment you walk in, you sense the chaos, the lack of professionalism, and a "make money, that's it" attitude.
The owners leave much to be desired. Their management is clearly mediocre, lacking ethics and dedication, where humane treatment and love for animals take a back seat. Everything seems to revolve around the business, not veterinary medicine.
The care is deficient, disorganized, and gives the impression that no one is truly in control of what's happening. It doesn't inspire confidence to leave your pet in a place where improvisation and administrative negligence seem to reign supreme.
A hospital like this shouldn't be operating as a hospital. If you value your pet, look for another option.

They saved the life of our 3-month-old pitbull we had just adopted. After only one day, they diagnosed him with parvovirus. During 10 very difficult days, his immune system dropped to zero, and the entire staff did absolutely everything possible for him.

Today, Lev is strong, healthy, and a happy dog. We are deeply grateful to the amazing team who never gave up on him.

The reception staff were very kind and attentive; however, the veterinarian who treated my dog ​​was indifferent and seemed to lack dedication. He asked me to explain the situation that had brought us there, and while I was speaking, it was clear he wasn't listening.
After the examination, he told me my dog ​​would have a bruise on his leg because he moved during sedation. However, his little arm was completely purple. I'm worried about how he'll be treated because my dog ​​is generally very calm. I hope I don't have to go back.

Terrible experience!

I took my Pomeranian in because he had been poisoned, and they told me it was neurological. They immediately wanted him hospitalized and scheduled tests for the next day.

The staff was completely unprepared; they couldn't even identify poisoning and gave a wrong diagnosis.

I don't recommend it. I went to a vet, and the diagnosis was accurate and reliable.

Don't take your pets there. Please. Here's the diagnosis.

There are a thousand other places.
Excellent service, they attended to my pet very quickly

On January 12th, I took Mora (an 8-year-old dog) for an urgent CT scan. I was told the results would be ready within 72 hours. Today is January 24th, and I'm only now receiving the results—only because I've repeatedly called this and all of your branches, as no one can answer my calls. I imagine there was a delay in processing the results, a heavy workload, staff shortages, or simply negligence, but at no point did you contact me to let me know the results wouldn't be available within the stated timeframe. If I hadn't been following up, you simply wouldn't have sent them. If you can't meet service standards, don't commit to them. I remind you that you weren't doing me a favor; I paid 8,000 pesos for the scan and interpretation. We're talking about Mora's health, and hopefully not her life. Like many of you, she's family, and her well-being is paramount, not just knowing how to quote prices and collect payment (which you do promptly and diligently). I waited anxiously for several days for something that, based on their sales timeline for the CT scan, should have been available much sooner. Looking at the date of the result, they had it available for days, but no one (laboratory, customer service, reception, doctors, coordinators, messengers, directors, partners) was able to assist me promptly. I don't know how they will mitigate the terrible experience I had, but I hope they can take this as an opportunity to improve. Respect and responsibility in healthcare services should be their priority. If the workload is overwhelming, they shouldn't accept any more clients. Special mention goes to Eduardo from Animalitos Miguel Ángel de Quevedo, who, although the service wasn't at that branch, went out of his way to help me find a solution.
Excellent location!!!
Thank you very much, Daniel, we are at your service!

At reception, when I arrived, they didn't tell me if I would be seen or not. Someone arrived after me (her pet wasn't registered either), and they saw her first. Then they told each other that the first girl, who was super stuck-up by the way, hadn't seen me. And then they took my information. Bad experience.

Excellent service and attention at Animalitos Polanco. The staff was always attentive to my furry brother's needs, and the customer service staff was also super attentive and friendly. Especially Ms. Liz, who helped me a lot and was always very attentive and kind despite being very busy.

They're taking advantage of the situation. I needed a travel certificate and they sold me unnecessary medication for the purpose of my trip. They're the experts; they should be guiding us instead of making up requirements.
Like everything else in that area, it's all purebreds. They think they're European. The clinic is excellent, they have everything the animal needs.

It took them three days to find our dog's lost test results (urgent tests), and we had to keep searching and asking to find out what had happened to them. Their administrative service is terrible. We also arrived 15 minutes late for an appointment with the supposed doctor who does ultrasounds, and because we were late, they wouldn't see us and kept all our money. Fifteen minutes cost us $1,500 according to their policies, which they explain after the appointment. The only good thing about the place was the veterinarian, but the terrible service, management, and attention far overshadow any diagnosis that took even 10 minutes. We don't recommend them; for the quality of the place, the service is far too expensive.
Excellent veterinary hospital, with specialties. But not only that, it has the best specialists in Mexico. The oncologist is very, very good, and the cardiologist too! Excellent, congratulations!
They have an excellent service in the area of ​​Physiotherapy

Terrible experience. I took my dog ​​in because he had been attacked by another dog, and they treated his wounds—everything was fine up to that point. But then his wounds weren't improving, and I had to take him back repeatedly, but he was still the same. So I decided to take him to another hospital, and there they realized they had left a catheter in one of his wounds, which was why it wasn't healing.

I take my dog ​​to physiotherapy with Dr. Itzel and she's the best. She's very caring and patient with him. His rehabilitation has been excellent; she restored his mobility and relieved all the pain he has due to his age and ailments. 100% recommended.

A huge thank you to the doctors! They sorted out the medical certificate for my dogs, and thanks to them I was able to travel without any problems 👍🏻✨ The service is also good and they are friendly. …
Excellent service in the physiotherapy area 🐶💗 …

Be careful about getting your travel medical certificates done at this place. The people who issue them (who aren't even doctors, they just sign them) are incompetent.

We got certificates for two pets:
- They got the names of the laboratories wrong for one.
- They gave the other an expired vaccine.

I'm going to report the expired vaccine to the authorities, as this is a clear case of serious negligence.

I can't speak to their medical services, but if such a simple procedure has these omissions and negligence, I can't imagine what they do in more serious situations…

The service is terrible. From the moment you arrive, they don't treat you well; they give you a time when they're going to take your dog for tests, and then they don't tell you that almost two hours later they still haven't done the tests.
Terrible service from both medical and administrative staff; my dog ​​went in with a dislocated elbow and came out fractured and terminally ill.

Terrible service
I took my dog ​​in very bad shape around 8 pm, a real emergency because she was having trouble breathing (she had a lung problem), and they kept us waiting. They even said they had appointments and couldn't see us even though they saw my dog ​​in that condition.
We left after waiting 40 minutes.
A very bad experience; I don't know what would have happened if we had stayed.
Don't take your dogs to this place in an emergency.

I love this place.

And the service is amazing.
Very friendly and professional. Highly recommended.
